Introduction

XLOV is a 4-member South Korean multinational boy group under 257 Entertainment (formerly known as JPark & Company). The group consists of Wumuti, Rui, Haru, and Hyun. They debuted on January 7, 2025, with their first single album "I’mma Be".

On December 17, Wumuti, a former Boys Planet contestant and member of WaterFire, was announced as the first member. On December 19, former Boys Planet contestant Rui was revealed as the second member, followed by Hyun on December 21. Finally, on December 23, former Boys Planet contestant Haru was introduced as the last member.

On January 14, 2025, the group announced their official fandom name, EVOL, which is "Love" spelled in reverse.
